title: デビュー戦の後に・めざすは日本一！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! I made it all the way to the end of my debut race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It hasn't really hit me yet. I'm still in a bit of a daze.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Anyhow! This means our journey towards the Twinkle Series has really begun!
Special Week manages to get through her debut and returns to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Now that we've achieved our first goal and made a successful debut, we should be deciding on our next race, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And now that we have to decide, I want you to know there's a race that I've always wanted to run in!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yup! A once-in-a-lifetime race that only classic year racers can take part in—one that determines the best of the generation!
choice_data_list: Are you saying what I think you're saying?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna race in the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna become the best in Japan, so I need to grab that Derby Umamusume title!
She's right. This race is basically a requirement for any Umamusume aspiring to be number one.
What's more, the news of Spe becoming a Derby Umamusume would reach all the way to her mother in Hokkaido for sure!
choice_data_list: All right! Our next objective is the Japanese Derby!
All right! Our next objective is the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You got it, Trainer!
Our goal is set, but Special Week doesn't have enough experience to challenge the Derby yet.
It would be wiser to run in a fairly popular race first. Which is why…
choice_data_list: Let's start with the Kisaragi Sho!
Let's start with the Kisaragi Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, a G3?! A graded race… Th-that's a lotta pressure…
choice_data_list: It'll give you some great experience.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …I guess I do need experience—especially if we're aiming for the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! I'll run in the Kisaragi Sho to learn what a real race feels like!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! Time to get started on my path to the Derby!
